title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: show HDMI content on both room displays
summary: Hold: the briefing says anything connected over HDMI becomes visible on both screens, although Microsoft describes a capability people can start and stop, not an automatic default. The admin route omits the device navigation, and the claims that Android administration roles and prerequisites beyond dual display mode are unpublished overlook documented requirements.

claims.claim: Microsoft's release notes advise maintaining a separate configuration profile for devices that require dual display support.
claims.quote: To avoid this, you must create and maintain a separate configuration profile for any devices that require dual display support.

claims.claim: A touch console is required for dual display configurations.
claims.quote: A touch console is required for dual display configurations.

claims.claim: Anything a presenter connects over HDMI becomes visible on both screens.
claims.quote: content you share through an HDMI connection can now appear on both screens at once. You can start or stop showing your content on both screens from the room controls.
claims.fix: Replace 'Anything a presenter connects over HDMI becomes visible on both screens' with 'HDMI-shared content can appear on both screens when people start the two-screen display from the room controls'. Do not state that connecting HDMI automatically activates the new behaviour.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes no sign-in, permission, identity or new data-access change for the room account.
claims.quote: On Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android with dual displays, content you share through an HDMI connection can now appear on both screens at once. You can start or stop showing your content on both screens from the room controls.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes user-controlled start and stop, not autonomous actions.
claims.quote: You can start or stop showing your content on both screens from the room controls.

claims.claim: The roadmap description does not mention content leaving the room or being shared into a meeting.
claims.quote: Make presentations easier to see from anywhere in the room, even when you're not in a Teams meeting. On Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android with dual displays, content you share through an HDMI connection can now appear on both screens at once.

claims.claim: Rollout mechanics specific to the new Android HDMI duplication feature are not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android HDMI content duplication admin setting API release channel prerequisites. Read roadmap record and opened rooms-release-note and device-settings-available; no feature-specific rollout mechanics beyond the roadmap target.

claims.claim: A release channel specific to the new Android HDMI duplication feature is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android HDMI content duplication admin setting API release channel prerequisites. Read roadmap record and opened rooms-release-note and device-settings-available; no release channel named for this new option.

claims.claim: Prerequisites beyond dual display mode are not yet published.
claims.quote: A touch console is required for dual display configurations. Dual display mode without a touch console is not supported nor certified.
claims.fix: Replace 'prerequisites beyond dual display mode are not yet published' with 'additional prerequisites specific to the new HDMI duplication option are not yet published'. This preserves the already stated touch-console prerequisite instead of denying it.

claims.claim: The on-device route to the matching dual display setting is Home screen > Settings > Teams admin settings > General.
claims.quote: On the device: Home screen > Settings > Teams admin settings > General > Turn on dual display mode > Swap screen.
claims.fix: Extend the on-device path to 'Home screen > Settings > Teams admin settings > General > Turn on dual display mode'. General is the correct page, but the printed path stops before the control.

claims.claim: Allow content duplication is documented on the Teams Rooms on Windows tab for showing content on both screens outside a meeting, not on the Android tab.
claims.quote:
# Teams Rooms on Windows
| Allow content duplication | Checkbox | Disabled by default. | When checkbox is selected, content is shown on both screens in dual screen mode, when out of meeting. Available for Individual or bulk changes. |

claims.claim: Roles required for the Android settings are not yet published.
claims.quote: Teams Device Administrator | Manage devices configured for use with the Teams service. | Manage device configuration and updates, review device health and status of connected peripherals, set up and apply configuration profiles, and restart devices.
claims.fix: Remove 'Roles required for the Android settings are not yet published.' General Android device and configuration-profile administration roles are documented; the absence of the new duplication setting does not establish an absence of administration roles.

claims.where: controls[0].governs and .note; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Dual display mode determines whether an Android room runs in dual display mode and is a prerequisite for dual display behaviour.
claims.quote: Dual display mode and swap screens admin control. IT admins can deliberately configure Teams Rooms on Android devices to run in dual display mode.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that the existing dual display mode setting is the new feature's own HDMI duplication control.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android HDMI content both displays duplication setting default rollout license November 2026. Opened rooms-release-note, room-planning-guidance and device-settings-available. Existing dual-mode documentation does not identify it as the new HDMI duplication setting.

claims.claim: The roadmap item names no licence.
claims.quote: Admins can use settings to manage how this works in their rooms.

claims.claim: Dual display mode is the one documented control that bears on this HDMI presentation feature.
claims.quote: On a Teams Rooms on Android device, you can disable HDMI ingest audio and automatic HDMI content sharing onto the front-of-room display (which also disables automatic sharing into a Teams meeting).
claims.fix: Replace 'Dual display mode is the one documented control that bears on this feature' with 'Dual display mode is a documented prerequisite control for this feature'. Existing Android HDMI-sharing controls also bear on presentation behaviour, even though the new duplication-specific control is undocumented.
